meta.title: Keyfly – Move in without a deposit
meta.description: Keyfly replaces the rental deposit: you don't have to set aside a fortune, and your landlord stays just as protected.

comingSoon.title: Move in without a deposit.
comingSoon.lead: For a flat renting at HUF {rent}, a three-month deposit is {deposit}. With Keyfly that money stays with you – and your landlord is still fully protected.

money.title: No need to save up a fortune
money.text: Pay a small monthly fee instead of a deposit. Your money stays with you – for the move, furniture or a safety cushion.

landlord.title: Your landlord stays protected
landlord.text: They get a coverage certificate from an insurer. If something goes wrong, they're paid quickly, without paperwork.

fast.title: A few minutes, on your phone
fast.text: Fill it in, confirm your income and see your offer straight away. No bank branch, no queues.
